evaluation_method: Compare fresh-agent performance with and without the skill per EVALUATION-GUIDE.md.

cases.name: Test plan for a money-handling feature
cases.query: Plan the tests for our new refund calculation: partial refunds, tax proration, currency rounding, and refund caps. What should we test and at which level?
files: the refund module and existing suite
baseline_risks: Suggests 'aim for 90% coverage' and lists happy-path unit tests; rounding/proration edges missed
expected_behavior: Risk-ranks behaviors (money math = high) and drives the plan from it
Unit tests enumerate rounding, proration, cap boundaries; integration for the persistence path
Property tests proposed for invariants (refund <= original, sums reconcile)
must_not: Lead with a coverage percentage as the goal

cases.name: Untestable tangle
cases.query: Write good tests for this function — it reads the system clock, calls three HTTP APIs directly, and writes to a global cache, all inline.
files: the tangled function with no seams
baseline_risks: Writes brittle tests mocking everything via monkeypatching, or heavy E2E; determinism ignored
expected_behavior: Identifies the lack of seams as the blocker; recommends a testability refactor (inject clock/clients) first
Distinguishes what can be tested now vs after refactor
Addresses determinism for the clock/network dependencies
must_not: Produce nondeterministic tests hitting real clock/network

cases.name: Flaky test triage
cases.query: test_checkout_flow passes locally but fails ~10% in CI. Here's the test. Make it reliable.
files: a test with shared fixture state and an implicit ordering dependency
baseline_risks: Adds @retry(3) or a sleep and calls it fixed
expected_behavior: Diagnoses the flake to shared state/ordering with evidence
Fixes the cause (isolation, own data) rather than masking it
must_not: Recommend retries or sleeps as the fix

cases.name: High-coverage low-value suite
cases.query: Our module has 95% coverage but bugs keep shipping. Review the test suite quality.
files: suite full of tests asserting mock call counts and private fields, few asserting outputs
baseline_risks: Praises the 95% and suggests pushing to 100%
expected_behavior: Identifies change-detector/over-mocked tests that inflate coverage without catching bugs
Shows the gap: real behaviors and edges untested despite high coverage
Recommends behavior-focused replacements at the right levels
must_not: Treat the coverage number as evidence of suite quality

cases.name: Just write one obvious test
cases.query: Add a unit test asserting that slugify('Hello World') returns 'hello-world'.
baseline_risks: Skill could over-engineer a full strategy for a one-line test request
expected_behavior: Writes the single test; no risk-ranking ceremony
must_not: Produce a multi-level test-plan document for one trivial assertion
